chapter.verse: “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, tuukhumna sungah kongpi lam pan lut lo a, lamdang pan kahto-a a lut mi in guta buluh ahi hi.
Kongpi pan a lut mi in tuucing ahi hi.
Kongcingpa in ama ading hon’ thei a, a tuute in ama kam a ngai uh hi. Amah in tuute a minin sam a, pua lamah a paipih hi.
Ama tuute khempeuh a khah khit ciangin a mai-ah pai a, tuute in a zui uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in ama aw a thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin midang nung a zui kei ding uh a; a kiang pan a taikhia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midangte’ aw a thei kei uh hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a hilh hi.
Tua thugentehna Zeisu in a hilh hangin, amaute in a khiatna a thei kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khatvei Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, keimah in tuukhumna kongpi ka hi hi.
Ka mai-a hong paite khempeuh in guta buluhte ahi uh hi. Ahih hangin tuate’ aw tuute in a ngai kei uh hi.
Keimah in kongpi ka hi hi. Mi khat in kei tung tawnin a lut leh, gal tawh kipelh ding a, sungtum pusuakin an nek ding lonona mun a mu ding hi.
Gutate in gu ding that ding leh susia ding longal a hong pai kei uh hi. Kei ka hih leh, tuute in nuntakna ngah tham loin nuntakna a dimtak a ngah nadingun kong pai hi.
Keimah in migi tuucing ka hi hi. Migi tuucing in a tuute tang dingin a nuntakna a paai hi.
Tuu neipa hi lo a kicial tuucing ahih leh, ngia hong pai a muh ciangin tuute nusia-in tai a; ngia in tuute manin a kithehthangsak hi.
Amah in a kicial hi a, tuute’ phat nading ngaihsun loin a taisan hi.
Migi tuucing ka hi hi. Pa in kei hong thei-a kei in Pa ka theih bangin,
ka tuute ka thei a; ka tuute in zong kei hong thei uh hi. Keimah in zong tuute tangdingin ka nuntakna ka paai hi.
Hih tuukhumna sunga om lo tuute zong ka nei lai hi. Tua tuute zong ka hong paipih lai ding hi. Amaute in ka aw a ngai ding uh a, amaute hon’ khat suakin tuucing khat a om ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in ka nuntakna ka lak kik dingin paai ka hih ciangin, ka Pa in kei hong it hi.
Ka nuntakna kuamah in hong sut kei hi, keima ut thu-in ka paai hi. Ka nuntakna paaikhia-a lakkik theih nading thu ka nei hi. Tua thu ka Pa in hong pia hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua thu hangin Judah mite kithutuak loin a kikhenthang kik uh hi.
Amau lakah mi tampite in, “Amah dawilawm nei mihai ahi hi; ama thu bang hangin ngai na hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Kimkhat in, “Tua thu in dawilawm neite’ thu ahi kei hi. Dawi in mittawte khua musak thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah ki-apna pawikhamna a om lai takin phalbi lai hi a;
Zeisu biakna innpi tual Solomon’ innliim ah a kawi pai hi.
Tua lai takin Judah mite in Zeisu kimkotin hong kikhawm uh a, “Bang tanvei ko hong lungkhamsak ding na hi hiam? Nang Khazih na hih leh, tangtakpi-in hong gen in,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Kong hilh khit hangin na um kei uh hi. Ka Pa’ min tawh ka bawl nalamdangte in ka teci ahi hi.
Ahih hangin note ka tuuhon sungah om lo na hih uh ciangin na um kei uh hi.
Ka tuute in keima aw a ngai uh a, ka tuute ka thei a, keima nung hong zui uh hi.
Keimah in amaute nuntak tawntungna ka pia a, cikmah ciangin a kisia kei ding uh hi. Kuamah in ka tuute ka khut sung pan hong sut zo kei ding hi.
Amaute hong pia ka Pa in na khempeuh sangin lianzaw ahih ciangin, ka Pa’ khut pan kuamah in a sut zo kei ding hi.
Keimah in ka Pa tawh pumkhat ka hi uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in suang tawh deeng dingin suang a tawm kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian kiang pan ka ngah thupha tampi kong lak zo hi. Tua thu lakah bang thu hangin suang tawh deeng dingin hong kipan na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Judah mite in, “Apha bawlna hangin suang tawh hong deeng ding ka hi kei uh hi. Nang mihing hi napi-in Pasian bangin na kibawl a, Pasian na gensiat maninah suang tawh hong deeng ding ka hi uh hi,” a ci kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in pasiante na hi uh hi ka ci hi,’ ci-in note’ Thukhamna lai sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian thu a ngahte in pasiante ahi uh a kicih leh, Pasian Lai Siangtho kinial lo ahih ciangin,
Pa in ama adingin a sian’thosak a, leitung ah a paisak keimah in, ‘Pasian’ Tapa ka hi,’ ka cih ciangin, ‘Pasian na gensia hi,’ hong ci na hi uh hiam?
Kei in ka Pa’ ut bangin ka gamtat kei leh, hong um kei un.
Ahih hangin, ka gamtat leh, kei nong um kei uh zongin ka bawlna thu um un. Tua bangin na up uh leh, Pa in kei sungah om a, kei in Pa sungah ka om cih thei-in na ciamteh ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in Topa mat nading a zon’ kik uh ciangin amaute’ khut sung pan a paikhia hi.
Johan in a masa bel a baptaizna mun Jordan gun galah Zeisu pai kik a, tuasan takah a om hi.
Mi tampite a kiangah va pai uh a, “Johan in nalamdang a lah loh hangin hih mi thu Johan in a genna khempeuh a man hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tuasan takah mi tampite in Topa a um uh hi.
